title: Rollback Rehearsal & Traffic Replay Playbook Prototype
creator: Elena Morales
description: Problem: Operators need confidence that a rollback will restore service without regressions. Current console rollbacks are opaque — users can't rehearse effects or compare candidate responses before flipping traffic. Goal: design a Rollback Rehearsal flow that lets engineers replay recent traffic against a candidate variant, surface semantic diffs for sample requests, and provide a one-click rollback plan with safety gates and annotated runbook entries. Non-goals: fully automated canary automation (this is a manual-assisted rehearsal UI), replacing backend traffic-capture storage (we will rely on ENG-7112 replay API).
acceptance_criteria: User can select a time window or saved snapshot of traffic and launch a replay against a chosen variant within the console
Prototype shows a side-by-side response diff explorer with token-level highlights and a severity score
UI surfaces recommended rollback steps (immediate rollback, staged rollback, shadow-only) with risk metadata and estimated cost impact
Flow includes explicit safety gates checkbox (metrics thresholds + approval) and creates a pre-populated runbook entry
Design has been reviewed by PM, Eng, and SRE and feedback captured in comments
prototypes: Figma prototype: frames 124:0 -> 124:42 (traffic selection + replay modal)
Figma prototype: frame 131:0 (Response Diff Explorer with token highlights)
decisions: Replay vs. live shadow: we will use replayed traffic for rehearsal to avoid side effects; a separate 'shadow on live' toggle left for later
Diff scoring: use a multi-factor score combining semantic similarity (embedding cosine), token edit distance, and user-configured sentinel prompts
Safety gates: present both metric-based (latency/error uplift) and human approval gates; defaults are conservative
Rollout options: expose three templated rollback plans (Immediate, Staged 50->0, Shadow only) to balance speed vs. diagnostic visibility

user_research: Interviewed 6 platform engineers: common anxiety point is not knowing what exactly changes after rollback
Observed 4 of 6 preferred sample-level diffs over metric-only dashboards when deciding to rollback
Users want saved rehearsal artifacts to attach to incident reports and postmortems
